_meta.purpose: ANC-v2 confirmatory stimulus + audio + scoring contract. Integers in samples are authoritative; seconds are derived display fields. Frozen at Stage 1 (2026-08-05) except values tagged dev_tunable, which DEV/PILOT may set using numerical + human evidence only and must freeze in config before CONFIRM scoring.
_meta.decisions: count DROPPED (D0/Study-1 only); 16-class pool; confirm_n=128 (deg-16 even balance). See paper/anc_v2_pool_decision.md, paper/anc_v2_design_pressuretest.md.
_meta.validator_rules: reject unknown keys; reject missing model revisions at seal time; reject inconsistent sample<->second fields; every stimulus/scoring/analysis value must appear here.

group_gain.rule: gamma = min(1, 10^(-1/20) / (max_w ||w||_inf + eps)) applied identically to every world+variant of a base pair; never peak-normalize individual worlds.

source_selection._stationarity_note: DEV gate so every source yields a clean trajectory ramp (dynamic sources fight the envelope). Frozen at 5.0 with a 12-class stationary pool (ESC-50 cannot robustly supply 16 stationary classes across folds). Dev_tunable.
source_selection._tune: active_fraction_min, crest_db_max are dev_tunable (Sec 4.2 step 5). crest_db_max frozen 18->26 in DEV fold-1 (admits impulsive-but-active textures; see results/dev_counterfactual_v2_searchlog.txt).

_classes_note: 12-class STATIONARY pool (trajectory stationarity gate <=5 dB). ESC-50 lacks 16 stationary classes across folds, so the pool shrank from 16 (the accepted cost of the stationarity-gate decision). Dropped dynamic classes (thunderstorm/pouring_water/crackling_fire/chirping_birds/frog/hen/snoring/brushing_teeth) -> reserves. Machine-heavy (8/12) but each machine is acoustically distinct (drone/clack/rotor/buzz/jet/hiss/whoosh).

pairing._n_note: 12 classes. confirm_n=108 -> even degree 18 (216/12); dev/pilot n=36 -> even degree 6. Set to 108 (not 120) because crickets yields only 19/24 stationary crops in folds 3-5 under the gate; degree 18 <= 19 is feasible for all 12 classes (verified folds 3-5). Preregistration re-frozen with this feasible config before any model contact.
pairing.reserve_pair_schedule: preregistered; used only on infeasibility, never after seeing model results
pairing.selector_objective: maximize min human clarity; NEVER use a model score

order.layout: two core slots, sequential; excerpts bit-identical across worlds (exact slot permutation)
order._note: salience-conflict variants; slot contrast 12 dB must match loudness_delta_db.

loudness.layout: two core slots, sequential (NOT overlapping); identity->slot fixed across worlds
loudness._note: delta_db dev_tunable; overlapping-mixture is a secondary robustness arm only, not primary.

trajectory.layout: two core slots, sequential; identity->slot fixed across worlds

anchor.layout: [e1] [beep in central gap] [e2]; beep waveform+indices identical across worlds

beep_removed.beep: silence, identical layout; control, not in primary strict rate

anchordist.layout: candidates fixed+bit-identical across worlds; only the beep moves

equidistant._note: null: no unique near/far target; analyzed as null margin, not strict crossover

qc_tolerances._trajectory_note: early_late 10->8, spearman .70->.60 in DEV (measurement was over-strict; the applied envelope is a clean monotone ramp, verified perceptible).
qc_tolerances.dispatch_rule: RENDERERS.get((property,variant)) else raise; NO catch-all else->duration branch

blinded_world_labels.role_source: manifest world-role map ONLY; never parse item_id or A/B names

frames.frame: Select the sound that {relation}, and describe it.
Focus on the sound that {relation}. Describe that sound.

loudness.positive: is louder than the other sound
loudness.negative: is quieter than the other sound

duration.positive: lasts longer than the other sound
duration.negative: lasts for less time than the other sound

anchordist.positive: is closer in time to the reference beep
anchordist.negative: is farther in time from the reference beep

prompts.freeze: human-verify opposing relation; inspect tokenizer with NO audio scores; freeze punctuation/carrier/template/spacing; hash prompts.json into seal.

scoring.prompt_aggregation: analysis-only, equal-weight; never average before serialization

model_panel_note: Frozen 7-model panel. revision/hashes MUST be pinned before CONFIRM (Stage 5); validator rejects null revisions at seal. gama/audioflamingo3 run fp32 sharded on 2 GPUs.
